ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMEROVERALLCREDITRATING_CRM] AS
BEGIN
-------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating
AS(
	SELECT 
	 BCM.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
    ,BCM.DTDATE1 AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BCM.STRTEXT21 AS CreditRiskId
    ,BCM.STRTEXT27 AS CustomerCreditRatingNote
    ,BCM.STRTEXT20 AS RiskRatingTypeId
    ,BCMD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCM.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCM.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID
    ,BCM.SOURCE_CODE
	FROM BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO_DELTA BCMD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO BCM ON BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID = BCMD.MISCELLANEOUSID AND BCM.BANK_ID = BCMD.BANK_ID AND BCM.isLatest = '1' 
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORGKEY,MAX(TMDATE) TMDATE FROM BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO WHERE isLatest = '1' AND  TYPE = 'Risk_Type' GROUP BY ORGKEY ) TMDATE ON TMDATE.ORGKEY = BCM.ORGKEY AND TMDATE.TMDATE = BCM.TMDATE --ADDED FOR DUP
	WHERE TMDATE.TMDATE IS NOT NULL
AND TYPE = 'Risk_Type'


UNION ALL
    SELECT 
	 BCC.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
    ,BCC.DATE1 AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BCC.STR21 AS CreditRiskId
    ,BCC.STR27 AS CustomerCreditRatingNote
    ,BCC.STR20 AS RiskRatingTypeId
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CORP_MISC_ID
    ,BCC.SOURCE_CODE
	FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO_DELTA  BCCD
	LEFT JOIN  BUSC.CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO BCC ON BCC.CORP_MISC_ID = BCCD.CORP_MISC_ID AND BCC.BANK_ID = BCCD.BANK_ID AND BCC.isLatest = '1' 
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORGKEY,MAX(TMDATE) TMDATE, MAX(CORP_MISC_ID) CMI FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO WHERE isLatest = '1' AND  TYPE = 'Risk_Type' GROUP BY ORGKEY ) TMDATE ON TMDATE.ORGKEY = BCC.ORGKEY AND TMDATE.TMDATE = BCC.TMDATE --ADDED FOR DUP
	WHERE TMDATE.TMDATE IS NOT NULL AND TYPE = 'Risk_Type'


)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,CreditRiskId
,CustomerCreditRatingNote
,RiskRatingTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,CreditRiskId
,CustomerCreditRatingNote
,RiskRatingTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating WHERE SOURCECODE = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL AND TGT.SOURCECODE = 'CRM';

-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[CreditRatingAgencyId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[CreditRiskId]
,[CustomerCreditRatingNote]
,[RiskRatingTypeId]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
  SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
, NULL AS CreditRatingAgencyId
, PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
, NULL AS PeriodEndDate
, CreditRiskId AS CreditRiskId
, CustomerCreditRatingNote AS CustomerCreditRatingNote
, RiskRatingTypeId AS RiskRatingTypeId
, SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
, SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
, 0 AS WorkFlowId
, 0 AS TaskRunId
, INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[CreditRatingAgencyId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[CreditRiskId]
,[CustomerCreditRatingNote]
,[RiskRatingTypeId]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
  CustomerId AS CustomerId
, NULL AS CreditRatingAgencyId
, PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
, NULL AS PeriodEndDate
, CreditRiskId AS CreditRiskId
, CustomerCreditRatingNote AS CustomerCreditRatingNote
, RiskRatingTypeId AS RiskRatingTypeId
, SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
, FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
, 0 AS WorkFlowId
, 0 AS TaskRunId
, INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');



DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA;

END
GO
